# Shelagh Powell

Shelagh Powell is a senior consultant physician (Overlæge) at Team 2 for school-age child psychiatry within the Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Department (Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Afdeling, BUA) at Aarhus University Hospital's Psychiatry division in the Central Denmark Region (Region Midtjylland)[^src1][^src3]. She serves as chair (forperson) of the steering group of the Danish ADHD-databasen, the national quality database that monitors the diagnosis and treatment of ADHD, and is credited as being responsible for leading the database's work[^src1][^src2][^src4].

Powell's name appears consistently across two annual reports from the ADHD-databasen: the report covering the period 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2024 and the following report, which for the first time incorporated data on the adult ADHD population and private hospitals[^src3]. In both reports she is listed among the "Forpersoner for ADHD-databasen" (chairs of the ADHD database) and identified specifically as "Forperson og repræsentant for RM" — chair and representative for Region Midtjylland[^src2][^src4]. The 2024 report notes that the database, published by Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut, was led jointly by Shelagh Powell and Simon Hjerrild, and documents both persistent challenges — rising referral numbers, longer waiting times, and declining performance on most quality indicators in Danish child and adolescent psychiatry — and modest progress, particularly in Region Midt, where there was a specific focus on improving registration practices and implementing shortened diagnostic pathways.

Powell's dual role — as a clinical leader within BUA at Aarhus University Hospital and as chair of a national quality database — places her at the center of efforts to standardize and improve ADHD care across Denmark's five regions, professional societies, patient organizations, and Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut, all of which are represented in the database's steering group[^src1][^src3].
